story.title: RIYA GROWS A PLANT
paragraphs_en: One day Riya finds a beautiful little plant in the garden while playing with her friends. "I am going to grow this plant at home",she said in excitement.
She takes it home and plants it in a pot.She places the pot under her cot in her room which was dark. "I will check you out after a week',she said to the plant.
She takes out the pot from under the cot after a week.She feels very sad as the plant started to dry off.
She shows the plant to her mother. "Riya,plants need sunlight and water to grow.How will it grow if you place it in a dark room without watering".
Her mother consoles her. "Don't worry.Let's grow another plant".
Her mother presents her a gift on her birthday.It contains a book which says 'How to grow plants?' and also a pot with few seeds in it.
She goes through the book thoroughly to gain idea on growing plants.
The next day morning,she sows the seeds in the pot by looking into the book.
She places the pot near the window where the plant can get enough sunshine.She also waters the plant regularly.
She feels extremely happy as her plant starts to grow in few days.
The plant grows tall in few weeks and she thanks her mother for the wonderful birthday gift.She also thanks the book for the helpful tips given by it.

Since plants prepare food by themselves,they are called autotrophs. Plants require water ,sunlight and carbon-dioxide to prepare food by a process known as photosynthesis(photo-light,synthesis-production).

sentences.text_en: She feels extremely happy as her plant starts to grow in few days.
sentences.text_vi: Cô bé cảm thấy vô cùng hạnh phúc khi cây của mình bắt đầu lớn chỉ trong vài ngày.

sentences.text_en: The plant grows tall in few weeks and she thanks her mother for the wonderful birthday gift.She also thanks the book for the helpful tips given by it.
sentences.text_vi: Cái cây lớn cao trong vài tuần và cô bé cảm ơn mẹ vì món quà sinh nhật tuyệt vời. Cô bé cũng cảm ơn cuốn sách vì những lời khuyên hữu ích mà nó đã mang lại.

sentences.text_en: Since plants prepare food by themselves,they are called autotrophs.
sentences.text_vi: Vì cây cối tự tạo thức ăn cho mình, chúng được gọi là sinh vật tự dưỡng (autotrophs).

sentences.text_en: Plants require water ,sunlight and carbon-dioxide to prepare food by a process known as photosynthesis(photo-light,synthesis-production).
sentences.text_vi: Cây cối cần nước, ánh nắng và khí carbon dioxide để tạo thức ăn qua một quá trình gọi là quang hợp (photosynthesis) (photo-ánh sáng, synthesis-tạo ra).
